Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODStorageUnit

GetName

The GetName method returns the name of this storage unit. 
ODStorageUnitName GetName ();
return value
The name of this storage unit, or kODNULL if the storage unit does not have a name.
DISCUSSION
When you no longer need the returned name, you should deallocate it.

EXCEPTIONS
kODErrZeroRefCount
This storage unit has a reference count of 0.
SEE ALSO
The ODStorageUnitName type (page 903).
